prompt: A highly detailed, cinematic steampunk portrait of a beautiful woman with dark hair styled in an elegant updo, seated at a cluttered wooden workbench. She has intricate gold mechanical prosthetic arms and delicate golden filigree facial markings on her cheek. She is focused intently on assembling a complex brass clockwork mechanism with tiny tools. To her right sits a polished metallic automaton head with exposed gears and lenses. The background is a dimly lit workshop filled with hanging blueprints, copper pipes, and glowing vintage oil lamps casting warm amber light. On the left wall, a chalkboard displays the Latin text "INVENIMUS AUT FACIMUS" in large letters and "DEFICIMUS" below it in green. The image is framed by an ornate Art Deco border featuring geometric patterns and a winged emblem at the bottom center. The color palette is dominated by rich browns, antique golds, deep blacks, and muted greens.

promptZh: 一幅细节丰富、极具电影质感的蒸汽朋克风格肖像画：一位黑发盘成优雅发髻的美丽女子，正坐在堆满杂物的木质工作台前。她装配着精密的金色机械义肢手臂，脸颊上绘有精致的金色花丝纹饰。她全神贯注，正用微型工具组装一套复杂的黄铜发条装置。在她右侧，摆放着一颗抛光金属自动人偶头颅，齿轮与镜片清晰外露。背景是一间光线昏暗的工作室，墙上挂满蓝图，铜管纵横交错，复古油灯散发着温暖的琥珀色光芒。左侧墙壁的黑板上用大字写着拉丁文“INVENIMUS AUT FACIMUS”，下方则是绿色的“DEFICIMUS”。画面四周环绕着华丽的装饰艺术（Art Deco）边框，饰有几何图案，底部中央点缀着一枚带翼徽章。整体色调以浓郁的棕色、复古金色、深邃的黑色与柔和的绿色为主。
